title: 4th hearing in Mehmet Yıldız's case
paragraphs: The fourth hearing has been held against East Post correspondent Mehmet Yıldız on charges of terror organization propaganda.
According to the indictment, Mehmet Yildiz reported police violence in custody published on June 2, 2025. The verdict was carried out: Anti-Terror Law 7/2 (terror organization propaganda).
The trial was held in front of Diyarbakır 9th Heavy Penal Court on April 16, 2026. The court adjourned the hearing until July 9, 2026.
In the Mehmet Yıldız case, Attorney Hakan Demirtaş said they object to the hearing being closed to observers.
Mehmet Yildiz works as a reporter at the Eastern Post as a reporter. Journalists' organisations said the case could have a deterrent effect on freedom of the press.
The prosecutor's office will present its original debate at the next hearing. Mehmet Yıldız is under arrest.
